image_description: A modern outdoor staircase featuring a sleek, metallic bannister system. The handrail is a continuous, tubular metal bar running parallel to the incline of the stairs. It is supported by thin, vertical metal balusters that are evenly spaced. The structure includes thicker vertical posts (newel posts) at the corners and ends for anchoring. The background shows a concrete wall, grassy terrain, and trees.
